items.title: 67559_Art Hodes oral history interview
items.q: I decided to find the ten best musicians I could find... So it turned out, seven was black, three were white. Mezzrow, Jack Bland and Art Hodes.

ctx.x: -- make it worse. For example, I had a job at the Astor Hotel. Ten men. I decided to find the ten best musicians I could find who were out of work on a Saturday. So it turned out, seven was black, three were white. Mezzrow, Jack Bland and Art Hodes. I couldn't get Rod Cless.
Yeah, and there's some question about Mezz.
